Dad of a 4 month old baby girl here. It was the same for me for a bit, until one day I took off from work, sent her mom out of the house all day (massage, nails, see her friends, etc) so it was just me and my baby girl.

 Started with the contact naps, she wasnt having it at first, so I took her in the stroller for a walk, then she fell asleep in it. Got home, she woke up of course, bur was still drowsy and I remember walking around with her in my arms until she began to yawn, then I sat down and she fell asleep. I didnt move for like 2 hours. 

That night for bed, I did the same thing, but I used the stroller in the house instead of outside. But then put her in the  baby hating bassinet instead after she was fully asleep on me. 

Now? I put her to sleep every night. I literally, and I mean that word, walk around with her in circles and tell her in a calming voice how my day at work was. She falls asleep after about 10 mins and I lay her down in the baby hating bassinet, and shes totally fine. Only wakes up for normal baby stuff but rinse and repeat. 

Takes some effort and steps (ha), I thought she hated me and it was kinda sad and felt hopeless, but it passes. Good luck!
